$comment: Visual scenes for the 13 key-art records (home, mode cards, loading, store, portal). Pure picture description: no titles, quotes, numbers or UI copy (those get painted in as text). build_keyart_prompts.py puts each in front of the record's fixed style and exclusion tail.
home_feature: Wide cinematic key art: several masked fantasy fighters of two rival sides clash on a broad carved stone road across a colossal sundial valley; cool blue-white morning light pours from the left over tall pale chalk spires, warm amber evening light from the right over low dark ironstone domes; bright shards of pale glass light and swirling ink smoke meet at the centre of the fight. Keep the left third calmer and darker for interface text; the action sits in the right two thirds.
home_tile_ranked_season: Painted card illustration: a lone masked fighter climbing a long flight of carved stone steps toward a bright sunlit summit plateau, the light growing stronger with every step, a feeling of ascent and earned rank. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.
home_tile_almanac_teaser: Painted card illustration: a great closed book of carved pale stone pages resting on a lectern of pale wood, thin lines of morning light escaping between its pages, a sense of a season about to begin. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.
home_tile_practice_tool: Painted card illustration: a quiet training yard on a stone terrace at dawn, wooden practice posts wrapped in cloth, an ash spear and a glass shield leaning on a wooden rack, soft cool morning light. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.
home_tile_collection_highlight: Painted card illustration: a gallery of carved stone alcoves, each holding a different masked fighter's outfit on a wooden stand, lit by warm amber lamps on one side and cool glass windows on the other. One clear focal subject, a darker band along the bottom for a caption.
mode_rift: Vertical poster-like painting: a colossal sundial valley seen from high above at the long hour, three carved roads crossing it from left to right, deep groves of fan-leaved trees between them, a round pale stone seat at the centre, tiny masked armies marching on the roads, cool light on the left rim and warm light on the right rim. A darker lower area for a title.
mode_bridge: Vertical poster-like painting: the fallen stone needle of a giant sundial lying across a deep misty gorge like a bridge, one road along its top, a glowing crack across its middle where two small groups of fighters meet, a cool glass arch at the far left end and a warm banded lamp gate at the far right. A darker lower area for a title.
mode_fray: Vertical poster-like painting: a round honed basalt plate under a white noon sun with no shadows anywhere, ten carved marks around its rim each lit in a different colour, a small lantern cart at its centre, many lone masked fighters scattered and duelling across the plate. A darker lower area for a title.
loading_map_bridge: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: the fallen stone shaft of a giant sundial needle lying across a deep blue misty gorge, a single paved road along its top from a cool glass arch on the left to a warm banded stone gate on the right, a crack across its middle glowing faintly, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
loading_map_fray: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: a round honed basalt plate set into a sunlit valley floor at noon, ten carved hour-marks around its rim, a small lantern cart at the centre, motes of light drifting down, no shadows anywhere, pale festival terraces around it, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
loading_map_rift: Wide painted panorama seen from high and far: a colossal sundial carved into an entire valley, three paved roads running left to right between a tall pale glass belfry on the far left and a low warm lamp dome on the far right, a hard band of violet shadow and a shallow stream crossing north to south through a round stone seat at the centre, groves of fan-leaved trees between the roads, epic scale, no characters in the foreground, a loading-screen backdrop.
store_banner: Wide painted banner: three masked fighters in elegant alternate outfits posing heroically on a carved sundial terrace in warm late light, strong rim light, celebratory but restrained; the left third calmer and darker for interface text.
portal_thumbnail: Game cover key art: a masked hero in the foreground on a carved sundial terrace, a rival fighter behind, pale glass light and ink smoke clashing between them, a fallen stone needle lying in the distance across a vast valley, cool morning light from the left and warm evening light from the right.
